hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

panes.label: Overview

text.strong: MBA in Finance at ATLAS ISME

text: is designed for future CFOs, financial strategists, investment managers, and fintech disruptors. Whether you aim to manage corporate finances, lead investment portfolios, or design financial innovations — this program equips you to lead in a dynamic global economy.

text.strong: You’ll learn to integrate financial acumen with technology, strategy with analytics, and governance with innovation

text: . From valuation to risk management, capital markets to fintech, corporate governance to sustainable finance — every subject is taught with real-world financial applications.

cards.title: Build expertise in financial modeling and valuation.
Design and analyze capital market investment strategies.
Apply advanced risk management frameworks effectively.
Integrate fintech, AI, and blockchain in finance.
Lead with strong ethics, governance, and compliance.
Drive business growth with strategic financial leadership.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester 1 builds strong foundations in communication, AI tools, and global business, while preparing students with essential leadership, planning, and career skills.

courses.title: Professional Communication and Presentation Skills- Career and Leadership Development - I
courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

courses.title: Driving Decisions by Excel And Modern Age AI Tools
courses.text: Master Excel from fundamentals to advanced analytics, covering data organisation, visualisation, forecasting, decision modelling, and generative AI tools to automate insights and solve complex business problems.

courses.title: Introduction to Digital Marketing
courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our Semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Early foundation in finance, global business, AI tools, leadership, and electives, blending theory with practical applications for future-ready financial expertise.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Semester 2 strengthens leadership, creativity, and research through people skills, design thinking, sustainability, and personal branding, aligning students with industry expectations and opportunities.

title.strong: Managing Self and People Skills with Human Centered Design Thinking- Career and Leadership Development- II

courses.text: Develops emotional intelligence, leadership, and teamwork skills; applies design thinking for user-centric problem solving; and strengthens personal branding and networking to enhance professional presence and career growth
Explores corporate social responsibility, sustainable development goals, and business research methods to integrate ethical practices and informed decisions into corporate strategies.

Develop skills in evaluating investment opportunities, risk-return tradeoffs, asset allocation, and portfolio construction strategies to maximize returns while managing financial risks effectively in dynamic markets.

Understand tax structures, compliance, and planning strategies. Learn how taxation impacts individuals and businesses, enabling effective financial decisions while ensuring adherence to regulatory frameworks.
Gain expertise in cost control, budgeting, variance analysis, and performance measurement to support managerial decision-making, efficiency improvement, and strategic business growth planning.

items.text: Explore India’s financial institutions, markets, and regulatory framework, understanding their role in economic growth, monetary stability, capital formation, and investment opportunities.
Learn strategies for personal finance, investments, estate planning, and risk management to build, preserve, and transfer wealth effectively across varying economic environments.

compare.title: Why our semester 2 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Emphasis on self-leadership, design thinking, sustainability, finance simulations, and early electives, ensuring applied learning, professional growth, and future-ready financial capabilities.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Semester 3 emphasizes human values, resilience, cybersecurity, and applied economics, strengthening ethical leadership and strategic decision-making for evolving global business environments.

courses.title: Organizational Behaviour & Human Values - Career and Leadership Development - III
courses.text: Learn to make strategic, big-picture decisions by evaluating competition, allocating resources, and planning for long-term success, while developing adaptability, resilience, and effective leadership in dynamic environments.

courses.title: Economics and Cyber Governance
courses.text: Applies economic theories to real-world business challenges, analyzing data, assessing trade-offs, and making strategic decisions, while integrating cybersecurity, risk management, and digital resilience for technology-driven business protection.
Provides hands-on industry experience and research opportunities, enabling practical application of skills, problem-solving, and development of actionable insights for real-world business challenges.
Teaches constructing dynamic financial models using Excel and advanced tools, enabling valuation, forecasting, and decision-making for investments, budgeting, and corporate financial planning.
Covers capital structure, cost of capital, mergers, acquisitions, and dividend policy, empowering students to make strategic financial decisions in corporate environments.
Explores capital raising, IPOs, M&A advisory, and deal structuring, equipping students with investment banking skills and real-world insights into high-stakes financial transactions.
Introduces options, futures, and swaps while emphasizing hedging, speculation, and risk control strategies essential for managing volatility in global financial markets.

items.text: Equips students with tools to analyze stock price movements, market trends, and trading strategies, fostering investment decision-making and portfolio management skills.
Focuses on financial planning, fundraising, venture capital, and risk assessment, enabling entrepreneurs to secure funding and manage growth effectively in dynamic markets.

semesters.title: Semester 4
semesters.text: Semester 4 integrates governance, ethics, analytics, and inclusive leadership, culminating in a capstone that equips students for impactful corporate decision-making roles.

title.strong: Corporate Governance, Professional Ethics & Law - Career and Leadership Development - IV

courses.text: Covers governance, legal frameworks, and ethics, ensuring compliance and accountability, while emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and capstone projects to apply leadership in solving complex, real-world business challenges.

Teaches analytical tools to optimize supply chains for efficiency, sustainability, and responsiveness, while providing corporate strategy frameworks to develop critical thinking, long-term vision, and effective business leadership.
Covers advanced valuation techniques including DCF, multiples, and transaction analysis, equipping students to assess company worth for investment or acquisition decisions.
Explores disruptive technologies, digital finance platforms, and entrepreneurial innovation, preparing students to evaluate and engage with emerging financial technology ventures.
Provides comprehensive understanding of banking operations, NBFCs, and insurance within BFSI, highlighting regulatory frameworks, risk management, and customer-centric financial services.
Focuses on data-driven insights, predictive modeling, and analytical tools to optimize financial performance, risk management, and strategic decision-making across businesses.

items.text: Examines investment strategies promoting environmental, social, and governance goals, integrating financial decision-making with sustainability and long-term positive societal impact.
Analyzes psychological influences on investor behavior, market anomalies, and decision-making biases, helping students understand irrational patterns in financial markets.
